blocks.text: Why B2B sales representatives need Excel on Mac

Your CRM is a database. Excel is your canvas. B2B sales often requires custom views that standard CRM dashboards cannot show. You might need to merge data from two different systems or calculate commission tiers that change every quarter. Doing this on a Mac is fast if you know the right tricks.
Essential Excel shortcuts for Mac users
Speed is your best friend when you have a list of five hundred leads to qualify. Stop using the trackpad for everything. Use these shortcuts to move through your data.

CRM exports are never perfect. You often get phone numbers without country codes or names formatted in mixed cases. Use the Proper function to fix names. Use Find and Replace with ⌘ + H to remove unwanted characters. If you have trouble finding the right tool, ask Lazur to point at the Data tab.

When your pipeline grows, scrolling becomes a chore. Use Freeze Panes to keep your header row visible. Go to View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row. This ensures you never lose track of which column is the deal value versus the close date.

items: Not using absolute references in formulas. Use ⌘ + T to toggle $ signs.
Hardcoding values instead of referencing cells. This breaks your sheet when data changes.
Ignoring data validation. Use it to create dropdowns for deal stages.
Overcomplicating formulas. Break them into smaller steps to make them easier to audit.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Excel files for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit cells, or change your files. It guides you or points at where you need to click.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is built for macOS only. There are no plans for a Windows version at this time.

faq.question: How do I fix leading zeros in Excel?
faq.answer: Select the column, right-click, select Format Cells, and choose Text. This prevents Excel from stripping the zeros.
